pretty_print.description: If true, enables pretty-printing of the JSON output (jo -p)

dedup_keys.description: If true, deduplicates object keys, keeping the last occurrence (jo -D)

disable_bool_detect.description: If true, treats 'true', 'false', 'null' as literal strings instead of booleans/null (jo -B)

ignore_empty_stdin.description: If true, does not produce an error on empty stdin (jo -e)

skip_empty_keys.description: If true, omits keys with empty or null values (jo -n)

use_array_mode.description: If true, generates a JSON array instead of an object (jo -a)

key_delimiter.description: Character used to separate components in object paths (jo -d). Empty means literal key=value syntax.

pairs.description: List of key-value pairs to include in the JSON object when not in array mode. Items are flat maps with 'key' and 'value' strings.

array_values.description: List of string values to include in the JSON array when use_array_mode is true.
